summary: Both blocking findings are valid and should be applied in spec-repair.

items.title: RunId/spec lookup is conflated with execution-context guarding
items.rationale: The finding identifies a real safety gap: resolving a requested runId/spec for display is not enough if the subsequent dispatcher commands still execute against the current context.
items.evidence: spec.json currently says runId status should return the requested runId even if a different context has an active flow, but next-action/run/finalize commands execute against ctx.flowState.

items.title: RunId target behavior omits active worktree resolution
items.rationale: The finding identifies a compatibility path required by this flow model: active worktree flow.json can live in the worktree, so runId guard/status must resolve worktree-mode active flows.
items.evidence: src/lib/flow-manager.js resolveByRunId scans active registry entries with loadReadOnly, while _loadActiveFlowState contains the worktree redirect behavior.
